body: Claiming B-2026-09-26-6: the evaluator-retry half (one more evaluate() call with the outcome text truncated - the prompt is what the reasoning choked on - only then the honest stop, which still learns the fan's facts first as landed today), plus the same guarantee for a world whose probe raises: asyncio.gather(return_exceptions=True) turns a raising probe into a failed Observation so one bad world call can no longer kill a whole fan. No new event kind; no renderer change. Faye (S010) holds B-2026-09-26-1 on the browser adapter - no overlap.
